dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: Ah, such fine weather — you think so too, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: I'm patrolling... and enjoying the weather as I do.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: Whether rain or shine, it's a good day for a Melusine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't bother you further, then.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: There's no problem. We can enjoy the weather together!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about the Melusines?

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: You'd like to know more about us?

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, we were born from the flesh and blood of the giant beast Elynas.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: Don't be shocked by that. Elynas is a gentle mother who taught us children how to survive in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: Later, however, Elynas ceased speaking, and so we asked Monsieur Neuvillette to take us to the Court of Fontaine to live.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: And that's how I came to be here, patrolling this place in my uniform. We've had lots of help — we're a very fortunate race, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: We work with human beings to protect Fontaine — such is the mission entrusted to us by Monsieur Neuvillette.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: Even though Monsieur Neuvillette has been very kind to us, we were only able to join the Marechaussee Phantom after going through training and tests, just like humans.

dialogues.speaker: Liath
dialogues.text: I guess this is the "fairness" that people from the Palais Mermonia keep talking about.
